Pest Control Work Order.Treatment(s)and Amounts: Insect monitor cards - 24 units; Tamper-resistant rodent stations with non-toxic monitoring blocks - 8 units; Pheromone traps for silverfish - 6 traps; No pesticides applied during inspection
